description: This file defines the NodesPool class responsible for initializing and managing nodes and credentials in the application. It includes methods for loading node modules, processing icons, and managing credentials, with dependencies on internal and external modules.

classes.name: NodesPool
classes.description: Class responsible for loading and managing nodes and credentials, including initialization routines and file processing.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes nodes and credentials by calling respective setup methods.

methods.name: initializeNodes
methods.description: Loads node modules, processes icons, and filters nodes based on categories, authors, and disabled list.

methods.name: initializeCredentials
methods.description: Loads credential modules and registers credential instances.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all files from a directory.
